title: Maximum Number Of Intersections On The Chart
description:
There is a line chart consisting of n points connected by line segments. You are given a 1-indexed integer array y. The kth point has coordinates (k, y[k]). There are no horizontal lines; that is, no two consecutive points have the same y-coordinate.
We can draw an infinitely long horizontal line. Return the maximum number of points of intersection of the line with the chart.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: y = [1,2,1,2,1,3,2]
Output: 5
```

Explanation: the line y = 1.5 has 5 intersections with the chart (in red crosses). You can also see the line y = 2 which intersects the chart in 4 points (in red crosses). It can be shown that there is no horizontal line intersecting the chart at more than 5 points. So the answer would be 5.

### Example 2

```text
Input: y = [2,1,3,4,5]
Output: 2
```

Explanation: the line y = 1.5 has 2 intersections with the chart (in red crosses). You can also see the line y = 2 which intersects the chart in 2 points (in red crosses). It can be shown that there is no horizontal line intersecting the chart at more than 2 points. So the answer would be 2.

## Constraints

- 2 <= y.length <= 10^5
- 1 <= y[i] <= 10^9
- y[i] != y[i + 1] for i in range [1, n - 1]
